The respondent/SLAO, Bangalore Development Authority, Bangalore has sent in L.A.C. No.

.2. The brief facts of the case is that the land bearing Sy.No.133/2 measuring 3 acres 24 guntas of Kadugondanahalli, Kasaba Hobli, Bengaluru North Taluka has been acquired by the B.D.A. for formation of Hennuru and Bellary road 2nd stage layout.

105/1994 C/w L.A.C. No. 458/2000 & 156/2000 fixed the compensation of Rs.3,18,047/-.
